name: Maid to Please
source:
Take control of the Main Character in a journey full of beautiful women to meet, befriend, and  eventually seduce. Among these, you will find the cute girl next door, a corrupt Police Officer, your dad's new wife, and of course, the Maid.

But beware, for all is not what it seems - you are also a man with a haunted past and dark secrets.

[From [url=https://gamesmtp.itch.io/maid-to-please]itch.io[/url]]
